nodes.label: Scope Discipline Rules
nodes.rationale: Fix the reported bug only, do not add abstraction layers or new packages not required by current task, do not introduce feature flags or backwards-compatibility shims for hypothetical future use. Prevents scope creep.

nodes.label: Ralph Loop Workflow
nodes.rationale: Used for well-defined iterative tasks with programmatically verifiable success criteria (tests passing, lint clean). Not for debugging incidents, tasks requiring mid-way design decisions, or one-shot queries.
